title: Jehoshaphat's Reign

questions.question: Who reigned in Asa's place?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:1 (ESV): "Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place and strengthened himself against Israel."

questions.question: Why was the LORD with Jehoshaphat?
options: Because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David
questions.correctAnswer: Because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:3 (ESV): "The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David..."

questions.question: What did Jehoshaphat NOT seek?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:3 (ESV): "...He did not seek the Baals..."

questions.question: What did the LORD establish in his hand?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:5 (ESV): "Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand."

questions.question: Who brought tribute to Jehoshaphat?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:5 (ESV): "And all Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat..."

questions.question: In which year of his reign did he send his officials to teach in Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:7 (ESV): "In the third year of his reign he sent his officials..."

questions.question: What did the officials, Levites, and priests have with them?
options: The Book of the Law of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: The Book of the Law of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:9 (ESV): "And they taught in Judah, having the Book of the Law of the LORD with them."

questions.question: What fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands around Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:10 (ESV): "And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah..."

questions.question: Did the surrounding kingdoms make war against Jehoshaphat?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:10 (ESV): "...and they made no war against Jehoshaphat."

questions.question: What did J ehoshaphat build in Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:12 (ESV): "...and he built in Judah fortresses and store cities."

questions.question: Who commanded 300,000 mighty men of valor from Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:14 (ESV): "Of Judah, the commanders of thousands: Adnah the commander, with 300,000 mighty men of valor."

questions.question: Who offered himself willingly to the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:16 (ESV): "And next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who offered himself willingly to the LORD..."

questions.question: How many seasoned troops were under Eliada from Benjamin?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:17 (ESV): "Of Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, with 200,000 men armed with bow and shield."

questions.question: What did the Philistines bring Jehoshaphat?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:11 (ESV): "Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute..."

questions.question: What did the Arabs bring him?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 17:11 (ESV): "and the Arabians also brought him... 7,700 rams and 7,700 male goats."

key_verse_text: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David. He did not seek the Baals.
